title: krigia biflora subsp. glandulifera
intro: Krigia biflora subsp. glandulifera, commonly known as Sandbill, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is a perennial plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief for various health issues. The health benefits of Krigia biflora subsp. glandulifera include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral agent, which can help in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and other phytochemicals that exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
